title: Mit Tennél? – Common Verbs in Every Person

sections.title: The pattern transfers
sections.content: Mit tennél? ("What would you do/put?", from tesz) is a common near-synonym of Mit csinálnál?, built on the same irregular stem you already used for the imperative (tegyél/tedd). menni ("to go") follows the same pattern: mennék, mennél, menne...

sections.title: tesz and megy in the conditional

items.english: In such a situation, what would you do?
I would definitely ask for help.

sections.content: Mit csinálnál? and Mit tennél? both ask the same thing — pick whichever comes to mind; native speakers use both.
